data.title: Man, 37, Makes $250K a Year But Has Just $1K Saved — And $250K in Debt
data.description:
A 37-year-old California father of three was earning more than $250,000 a year, but his finances looked nothing like his salary.



He had just $1,000 saved, nothing invested for retirement and roughly $250,000 in debt.
